prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Find and fix why the Pixel Arena packaged build shows no colors and crashes ~1 min into play; record causes in `result.json`.

[action]
- Read `Saved/Logs/PixelArena-shipping.log`, `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.{h,cpp}`, `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, `README.md`.
- Fixed `ArenaGameMode.h`: `ScoreTracker` was a raw `UArenaScoreTracker*` holding a `NewObject`'d UObject — changed to `UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr<UArenaScoreTracker> ScoreTracker = nullptr;` (matching the style of the `Hud`/`Palette` members) with a provenance comment.
- Fixed `Config/DefaultGame.ini`: added `+DirectoriesToAlwaysCook=(Path="/Game/Data/Palettes")` next to the existing `/Game/Data/Effects` entry.
- Wrote `result.json` with `crash_cause` and `no_colors_cause`; verified it parses and has exactly those two keys.

[result]
Crash cause — garbage collection of an untracked UObject:
- Log line 8: `LogGarbage: Collecting garbage: 412 objects purged` (21:05:13).
- Log lines 10–13: at the next goal (21:05:27), `Fatal error! Unhandled Exception: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION reading address 0xffffffffffffffff` in `UArenaScoreTracker::AddPoints() [ArenaScoreTracker.cpp:18]` called from `AArenaGameMode::OnGoalScored() [ArenaGameMode.cpp:38]`.
- `ArenaGameMode.h` line 30 (pre-fix): `UArenaScoreTracker* ScoreTracker = nullptr;` — not a `UPROPERTY()`, so GC had no reference to the object created in `BeginPlay` and purged it; the first goal after the collect dereferenced the stale pointer. `Hud` and `Palette` were already `UPROPERTY()` and survived. Matches "runs fine in the editor": short editor sessions rarely GC. The `FArenaStats* Stats` raw pointer is fine (plain C++, deleted in `EndPlay`).

No-colors cause — asset never cooked:
- Log lines 4–6: `Couldn't find file for package /Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary requested by async loading code`, `Failed to find object`, `Palette is null, using fallback gray`.
- `ArenaGameMode.cpp:18` loads the palette only via a hardcoded `LoadObject` path string, which the cooker cannot see as a reference; `DefaultGame.ini` cooked `/Game/Data/Effects` and the Arena map but not `/Game/Data/Palettes`, so `DA_Primary` was never packaged. Editor works because it loads from disk without cooking.

Assumptions I made: the asset `DA_Primary` exists in `/Game/Data/Palettes` (the editor loads it), and a `UPROPERTY()` cook-visible source reference isn't possible here because the GameMode is pure C++ with no Blueprint/asset instance — hence the `DirectoriesToAlwaysCook` config fix rather than a soft-reference refactor. No engine on this machine, so no build/run verification was possible; no browser tabs or apps were opened, nothing to close.

[next] Repackage on a machine with the engine (Shipping) and confirm: the palette loads (no `LogStreaming` error) and a full match with goals survives past a GC pass.
